replies.author: BratPit24
replies.body:
Ok. So on mobile the absolute key is the ctr which is click through rate.

So you make a BUNCH of test ads.you ab test them. Even tiny differences matter. Start in cheap countries. Scale in USA. These are the basics. Good luck

comments.author: mirageofstars
comments.body:
I mean ask AI. But in general you’ll want to build interest by posting and sharing, you’ll need killer marketing content/teasers, then if you’re going with Steam you want to build up your wishlist before launch, make sure your early launch has good reviews. Get influencers to talk about your game and say how amazing it is, etc. 

It’s still an uphill battle. If your game doesn’t have a strong hook and killer look, it’ll most likely be a washout. But that’s the case with most creative industries now.
